description: 北九州市 雨水貯留施設一覧 [stormwater and drainage] is a dataset listed in BODIK Open Data Catalogue Service (data.bodik.jp), Japanese local governments, an open data portal, published or maintained by 北九州市. 北九州市が整備した雨水貯留施設の一覧です。 雨水貯留事業：昭和53年度に制度化された事業で準用河川改修事業の内、都市河川に係るもので、治水計画上、河道改修よりも調整池方式が適切なものに対して、雨水貯留施設の整備を行うものです。. Coverage: 北九州市. The portal files it under the publisher 北九州市. Its tags are リスト. It offers 1 resource(s) in xlsx. The portal shows 2025-03-28 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Japanese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons Attribution. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support urban drainage and flood-risk studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-jp-bodik-portal.
